messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 ALERT — region=eu-west high error rate (5xx) and elevated pod restarts. Paging oncall @devon. See: https://grafana.redwood/inference/eu-west/overview

devon: Acknowledged, I'm on it. Checking regional summary and router logs.

maria: I see a rapid increase in origin hits from the edge (eu-cdn-05). Cache hit rate dropped from 92% to 18% in 6m. Redis eviction logs show `maxmemory reached` spikes.

sam: Also seeing a spike in model-host heap growth on several hosts in eu-west. Might be a double hit: cache stampede -> surge in model invocations -> memory pressure -> restarts.

alex: Quick mitigation — throttling heavy API keys and scaling inference pool. Commands run: `routerctl throttle-key --key=K_*** --limit=20r/s` and `kubectl scale deploy inference-eu -n prod --replicas=14`.

ops-bot: Autoscaler triggered +8 pods. New pods starting, healthchecks passing.

priya: Running a config diff: there was a cache-policy tweak merged last night (LRU->allkeys-lru) plus a CDN origin failover that increased origin TTL=0. That likely caused cache churn. Rolling back CDN origin fallback and restoring mempolicy.

devon: After the rollback and throttles, 5xx decreased from 44% -> 7% in 4m. But we still have noisy alert churn: we got 3 pages while autoscaling happened. Need better alert dampening.

jordan: For alert noise reduction propose: composite alert that combines 5xx rate with pod_restart_rate or oom_count and honors operator annotations (maintenance=true). Sample logic:
```
alert if (regional_5xx > 0.25 for 5m) OR (regional_5xx > 0.15 for 3m AND pod_oom_rate > 1% for 5m)
silence if annotation maintenance=true OR drain_in_progress=true
```
Also add a short suppression window (60s) when autoscaler increases replicas by >30% to avoid paging during expected churn.

maria: Agreed. Also add an explicit OOM alert: `increase(container_ooms_total[5m]) > 0` to quickly point to memory regressions vs transient 5xx.

sam: I'll open infra-monitoring PR with both composite rule and autoscale-suppression hook. Will include unit tests and examples in `alerts/tests/test_region_alerts.py`.

alex: We should also add post-incident synthetic checks per region. Proposed: cheap inference probe every 30s performing a small prompt, record success, p50/p95 latency, and report a region success_rate metric.

devon: If success_rate < 90% for 2m trigger a routing-fallback alert (not immediate full failover). The fallback automation should shift traffic in steps: 20% -> 50% -> 100%, validating success at each step. If the target region shows errors, rollback.

priya: Safety note: during any automatic reroute, router should prefer stable model variants (non-quant) for new sessions — a `safe_mode` flag. Helps avoid memory surprises.

incident-bot: Created incident #1961209876 thread channel: #incident-1961209876. Status: ACKED.

sam: Action items from my side: PR for composite alert + autoscale suppression (infra-monitoring) — ETA 48h. PR will include a `silence-if` annotation and tests. I'll also add an example Prometheus rule snippet in the PR description.

maria: I'll run a memory bisect on the model-hosting binary (suspect regression in recent mempool allocator change) and upload artifacts to /mnt/incidents/1961209876/bisect.tar.gz — ETA end of day.

alex: I'll spin up a Grafana dashboard template: `Regional Health Overview` with panels: per-region success_rate, p50/p95 latency, pod_oom_rate, pod_restart_rate, cache_hit_rate. Will prototype and share link.

devon: Can we also add an alert cooldown when engineers initiate drains/drain-mode annotation? We kept getting alerts during draining. Example: if `drain_annotation=true` present on >3 nodes then suppress region-level 5xx alerts for 90s.

jordan: Let's schedule a failover drill in staging to validate gradual reroute semantics and safe_mode behavior. I can coordinate a 1-hour runbook exercise next week.

customer-success: FYI — CS asked for a short templated message to send to customers in impacted regions when we trigger automated reroutes. Suggest adding a checkbox to the runbook.

ops-bot: Noting: incident state moving to MITIGATED -> INVESTIGATING for follow-ups. Timeline artifacts saved: /mnt/incidents/1961209876/timeline.log

devon: Summary / next steps:
- sam: infra-monitoring PR for composite alert + suppression (48h)
- alex: grafana dashboard prototype (24h)
- maria: memory bisect and artifacts upload (EOD)
- jordan: failover drill plan and runbook updates (4 days)
- priya: cache config preflight added to infra-change checklist (today)
- customer-success: pre-approved template for customer notifications (48h)

maria: One more note: add an automated preflight check for cache config pushes that runs synthetic cache-warm probes in a canary namespace. If warmup fails, block rollout. I'll open a ticket.

sam: Good coordination. After PR merges, run a staging test that simulates a regional cache miss storm and verify alerts only page once real sustained degradation happens.

incident-bot: Incident 1961209876 status: ACKED -> MITIGATED -> PENDING_POSTMORTEM.

alex: Thanks everyone. Closing the pager, keeping thread for postmortem items. Will post meeting notes after the debrief at 2025-11-10T15:00UTC. :thumbsup:
